state.task: What courses does this school offer? Report every course name.

actions.description: Look up this school's own content to answer a visitor question. Read-only retrieval across the school's profile (name, about, contact links) and the full course catalog: titles, descriptions, learning outcomes, tags, instructors and syllabus outlines (chapters and lesson titles). Returns matching content sections with their page paths — compose the answer from them. Use for questions like "do you have a beginner Python course?", "what does the SQL course cover?" or "who runs this school?". Returns empty matches when the site has nothing on the topic.

query.description: Natural-language question or keywords to look up

actions.description: Search this school's published course catalog. Read-only. Filter with a free-text query (matches titles, descriptions, outcomes and tags); with no query it lists the whole catalog. Returns structured matches — name, course_id, description, tags, instructors, page path — and navigates the page to the catalog results so the user sees the same list. Returns an empty list when nothing matches.

Get full detail for one this school course: description, learning outcomes, instructors and the complete syllabus (chapters with lesson titles), plus the signed-in learner's enrollment status. Read-only. Pass course as a name or a course_id from search_courses; the page navigates to that course so the user sees it.

Enroll in a this school course (free enrollment). Enrolling requires a signed-in account: while signed out this tool does NOT enroll — it opens the sign-in page and returns guidance. After the user signs in, call it again to complete the real enrollment. Pass course as a name or course_id from search_courses.

Sign in to this school with an email and password. Do this first for anything tied to an account — enrolling in a course, or reading your progress — because those tools only exist once signed in. Browsing and course questions do not need it. After signing in, re-list the tools to see what became available.
The task is complete. Report an answer supported by the observations.
Stop because the task cannot be completed with the available actions or evidence.

actions.description: Search Phase One School's published course catalog. Read-only. Filter with a free-text query (matches titles, descriptions, outcomes and tags); with no query it lists the whole catalog. Returns structured matches — name, course_id, description, tags, instructors, page path — and navigates the page to the catalog results so the user sees the same list. Returns an empty list when nothing matches.

Get full detail for one Phase One School course: description, learning outcomes, instructors and the complete syllabus (chapters with lesson titles), plus the signed-in learner's enrollment status. Read-only. Pass course as a name or a course_id from search_courses; the page navigates to that course so the user sees it.

Enroll the signed-in learner in a Phase One School course through the school's own enrollment flow (free enrollment — no payment). State-changing: the course is added to the learner's personal learning trail, its lessons unlock, and the page shows the enrolled state. Pass course as a name or course_id from search_courses. If already enrolled, returns current progress instead of enrolling twice. If a course name is ambiguous, it returns the candidates and enrolls nothing — retry with the exact course_id.

The signed-in learner's personal learning state at Phase One School: every enrolled course with completed/total lessons, progress percent and the next lesson to take. Read-only, session-scoped — no arguments needed. Pass resume ("latest" or a course name/course_id) to also navigate the page to that course's next lesson so the learner continues where they left off. "latest" means the most recently listed enrollment.

resume.description: Optional: "latest" (the most recently listed enrollment) or a course name/course_id — navigates to its next lesson
